Subject: Purchase order stamping and invoice submission

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking the time on the intro call yesterday. Our AP team asked for one clarification we didn't get to: what exactly do you need from us on 'PO stamping' and the invoice XML? Our system (Finora AP) requires a visible PO number on the PDF for three-way-match, and our EDI team prefers PO line references in the XML (POLineID).

For EU VAT reconciliation we also need to confirm whether Redwood will include the vendor VAT ID and whether the invoice should carry the buyer's VAT element or if you support self-billing. Can you send your AP onboarding packet and a sample XML and PDF we can run through our UAT?

Also looped Tom from Procurement (he manages our supplier provisioning).

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement
Finora S.p.A.

Attachment: none
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finora.it>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-22 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order stamping and invoice submission

Elena — thanks, this is straightforward to support.

Quick summary of Redwood's requirements and options so your AP/EDI teams can pick the path that fits Finora:

- Visible PO on PDF: we require the customer PO number to be displayed in the header of the invoice PDF (recommended: top-right, labelled PO: <PO_NUMBER>). This is sufficient for manual three-way match.
- Machine-readable fields (preferred): include the following elements in your invoice XML / UBL / cXML payload: POReference (PO number), POLineID, InvoiceReference (unique invoice id), BuyerLegalEntityID (Finora's GL / cost center if you want autopush), SupplierVAT (Redwood VAT id).
- PO stamping vs acceptance stamp: we do NOT require a physical/graphic acceptance stamp. 'PO stamping' in your policy is satisfied if the PO number and POLineID are present and the PO has a matching status in your system. If you must have an acceptance stamp we can include a 'AcceptedBy' XML element or an embedded PDF overlay as part of our invoice generation flow.
- EU VAT / self-billing: Redwood can include its VAT ID on the invoice and the invoice will show the supplier VAT element. If Finora prefers self-billing (Finora issues invoices on our behalf), that is supported but requires a self-billing agreement signature on your letterhead — we typically handle that by DocuSign.

I'm attaching our AP onboarding packet and a sample invoice XML and a short MAP (mutual action plan) template. See attached stubs.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred integration (PDF-only or PDF + XML).
2) We provide a test invoice (staged) into your UAT environment with a sample PO for matching.
3) Run a single match test and confirm field mapping (PO, POLineID, InvoiceRef, Remit IBAN).

Happy to jump on a 30-min session with your AP/EDI team if helpful.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0143

Hi Elena — quick follow from Finance/Legal: a few clarifications so your AP team can validate acceptance in Finora's onboarding checklist.

- Required fields for automated payment: PO number, Invoice number, Invoice date, Net amount, Tax amount, Total, Supplier VAT ID, Supplier remit details (IBAN/Swift or bank name + account). If you send XML, include the currency and payment terms element (Net 30 by default).
- Matching tolerance: Redwood supports PO line-level matching. If Finora's system requires an exact POLineID, please map the field to POLineID in the sample XML.
- Vendor remit identifier: if you need a 'Supplier Remit ID' in your system, we can emit the Redwood vendor code you provide. Please send that code or confirm the field name.
- VAT evidence: for EU cross-border, we'll attach our VAT certificate on request. If Finora requires a reverse-charge annotation, please state the exact invoice footnote text to include.

We can produce either: (A) a human-readable PDF with the PO in header + an attached UBL file, or (B) a fully formed UBL delivered to an SFTP/endpoint. Option A is faster to get to UAT.

If you confirm option A, we will deliver a test PDF and the matching UBL file.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finora.it>

Subject: Re: Purchase order stamping and invoice submission

Thanks Kim and Sergio — this is very helpful. We prefer Option A (PDF + attached XML) to start; our EDI team will validate the UBL later. A couple of quick asks so we can provision the supplier record in Coupa: 

- Can you include a single 'Supplier Remit ID' field in the XML and tell us what Redwood will send there (your internal supplier code)?
- Our AP requires the IBAN on the PDF for bank routing — can Redwood place Remit IBAN in the payment block?
- For VAT: Finora will apply reverse charge for cross-border services. Please include the following footnote verbatim on the invoice if reverse charge applies: 
  "Reverse charge applies under Article 44, Council Directive 2006/112/EC. Recipient liable for VAT."

If you can confirm those three items and send the AP packet we will create the supplier record and aim for an internal test on Apr 27.

Best,
Elena

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-24 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase order stamping and invoice submission

Elena — confirmed. Short answers:

- Supplier Remit ID: we will include a field SupplierRemitID in the XML. Our default value for new customers is the Redwood vendor code 'RDW-FIN-<short>'. Once Finora creates the Coupa record, send us your supplier id and we'll echo it back in subsequent invoices.
- IBAN on PDF: yes, we will include Remit IBAN in the payment block of the invoice PDF. Please share the exact IBAN you want payments routed to.
- Reverse charge footnote: we will include the exact text you provided when the invoice has a reverse-charge flag; we can toggle that per invoice if you tell us the condition (e.g., billing country vs buyer country).

Next steps:
1) I uploaded the AP packet and MAP to a shared Drive for the implementation team: https://drive.google.com/finora-redwood-ap-packet (stub).
2) I'll send a DocuSign link for the vendor setup and self-billing agreement if needed: https://app.docusign.com/sign/XYZ123 (stub).
3) Redwood will deliver a test PDF + XML to your UAT on Apr 27. If all good, production cutover the week of May 3.

If you'd like I can set a 30-minute mapping call (we'll include our EDI engineer).

Thanks,
Sergio
Partner Sales — Redwood Inference
